skill.summary: Complete Tailwind CSS documentation. Use when working with Tailwind CSS utility classes, responsive design, dark mode, animations, custom configurations, plugins, or styling questions. Covers all utility classes, modifiers, configuration options, and best practices.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Tailwind CSS skill, providing complete documentation and coverage for all utility classes, responsive design, configuration, plugins, and best practices.
- Documentation is organized into modular `.mdx` files by topic, accessible via a clear structure and quick reference table.
- Supports key topics: setup, utility classes, customization, dark mode, plugins, advanced features, and common styling tasks.
- Includes guidance on how to navigate and leverage the embedded documentation for various Tailwind CSS questions.
